title: Dryer door latch, Chinese parts assembled in Thailand
description: Scenario 2 of N351460: finished Chinese housing, lever and spring are pressed together in Thailand.

predict.facts: The product in question is a door latch, model number 308D1127P001, for a front-loading dryer. This article is used in the drying machine’s door lock system and is comprised of a specially shaped plastic housing, lever, and a metal spring. The door latch is secured to the dryer’s door, and acts as a mating part for the machine’s door strike on the drying machine, securing the door in the closed position. All three components (housing, lever, and spring) are of Chinese-origin and ready for assembly when they arrive in Thailand, where the spring is hand-attached to the lever and housing and all three components are quickly pushed together using a manual table-top press.

notes: Facts are CBP's sentences from N351460, one scenario each (scenario 2 restates the shared assembly step in place of 'as described in scenario 1'). Prediction only; precedents dated before 18 Jul 2025 (request date).
